s:Reason.s:Text: The WS-Management service cannot complete the Pull operation for the enumeration because the wsman:MaxEnvelopeSize, wsen:MaxCharacters or wsen:MaxElements parameters differ from those specified to the enumeration. The application needs to specify the same parameters for Pull as were specified for the enumeration.
